tolerance_basis: Sensitivity benchmark only; not an aviation regulatory limit
calibration_A: September flights ordered by takeoff, first third
calibration_B: September flights ordered by takeoff, second third
risk_calibration_C: September flights ordered by takeoff, final third
feature_availability: Compare inherited retrospective features with version excluding landed-derived flight_duration_min and remaining_to_landing_min
selection: Fixed relative half-width threshold grid plus flight-block CRC on disjoint C
inventory: Observed labeled intervals only, not full-flight or global emissions; same-predictor imputation must equal all-point total
decision_rule: Report every outcome; no method chosen or tuning performed using October; no claim of new theorem or established novelty
